subject: Planning: product walkthrough + security & procurement loop
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@velotech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Planning: product walkthrough + security & procurement loop

Hi Sam — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Recap:
- Primary goals you outlined: reduce inference latency for your in-house summarization pipeline, tighten model cost per request, and validate SSO/integration surface for production.
- Constraints: existing SSO via Okta, internal security questionnaire (we understand SOC2 is required), and procurement prefers a short pilot PO before committing to reserved capacity.

Proposed immediate next step: a 60–75 minute technical walkthrough/demo where we:
1) show a short live demo of the inference path (15–20m)
2) deep-dive on integration (SSO, routing, KV cache) (25–30m)
3) Q&A and procurement/security checklist review (15–20m)

Please select one of these windows (all PST):
- Option A: Wed 11/11, 10:00–11:15
- Option B: Thu 11/12, 14:00–15:15
- Option C: Fri 11/13, 09:00–10:15

Ask: please confirm the core attendees from your side (technical + security + procurement). If procurement/security need to be looped in but can only attend the last 20 minutes, that works — we’ll timebox the compliance items.

I’ve attached a lightweight demo-agenda.md with the flow and a short list of artifacts we typically share (SOC2 summary, data handling notes). If you can share the name/email of your procurement and security contacts I’ll loop them in and include Marissa (contracts/CS lead) and Sean (security reviewer) from our side.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: demo-agenda.md (MD)]

Procurement notes / asks for Priya:
- We typically start pilots with a short pilot agreement (30 days), then instrument usage-based billing. If you have specific terms you need (PO number, invoicing cadence, tax forms), please send them ahead of time.
- Please share any contract templates or clauses we should review (data residency, subprocessor lists, indemnity caps).

Security items for the call (what Sean will cover):
- SOC2 scope and control mapping (we’ll reference the attached SOC2-summary.pdf)
- SSO integration points and recommended flow for Okta
- Data retention defaults and tokenization options

Attaching a quick mutual action plan we use to track owners: proposed-MAP.xlsx. Priya — if you can populate procurement milestones (PO, billing contact, legal review timeline) before Thu we can incorporate them into the call.
